claims: An official OpenTelemetry HTTP exporter sends a standards-based GenAI span into the real Chorus OTLP receiver
Chorus displays persisted service, model, latency, token usage, and currency-aware cost
Default manual promotion accepts a trace marked generated and persists a trace-linked evaluation case
demoCommands: official OpenTelemetry SDK plus OTLPSpanExporter to http://127.0.0.1:8112/v1/traces, then browser Promote
isolation: Dedicated /tmp corpus, synthetic evidence-agent data, localhost only, no production services or message delivery
limitations: Local OTLP HTTP path only; no production deployment or external collector
